title: The Chronicles of Bone
synopsis: A monthly fantasy-action series with 40+ characters across 5 planned seasons, created by Kavan Cardoza using Freepik and Magnific.

audienceReactions.quote: I can't put into words how great I find this web series. After a few minutes you forget that you are watching an AI video. Phenomenal work. Thank you.
audienceReactions.author: @Squirrelshagger

audienceReactions.quote: I don't care if it's AI, that's some of the best story telling I've seen in a while.
audienceReactions.author: @717PROJECT

audienceReactions.quote: Simply breathtaking. This is the golden standard for AI filmmaking right now.
audienceReactions.author: @TheVirtueSaga
